error[ZBX-E0531]: the ECR repository may not be read by this identity
  cause  123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com refused the AWS identity
         for the repository fixture/cdn
  host   123456789012.dkr.ecr.us-east-1.amazonaws.com
  repo   fixture/cdn
  perm   ecr:BatchGetImage
  fix    allow ecr:BatchGetImage and ecr:GetDownloadUrlForLayer on the repository
         or pull with an identity of the account that owns it
  more   zbx explain E0531
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0531.html
